records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form string="Put in Pack">
                <group>
                    <field name="package_type_id" placeholder="Select a Package Type" options="{'no_create': True}"/>
                    <field name="result_package_id" domain="[('package_type_id', '=?', package_type_id), '|', '|', ('location_id', '=', location_dest_id), ('id', 'in', origin_package_ids), '&', ('location_id', '=', False), '|', ('move_line_ids', '=', False), ('move_line_ids.location_dest_id', '=', location_dest_id)]" context="{'default_package_type_id': package_type_id, 'show_src_package': 1}" widget="package_m2o" placeholder="Leave empty to create new"/>
                </group>
                <footer>
                    <button name="action_put_in_pack" type="object" string="Put in Pack" class="btn-primary" data-hotkey="q"/>
                    <button string="Discard" special="cancel" data-hotkey="x" class="btn-secondary"/>
                </footer>
            </form>
        </field>
